title: Grenadier Flood
openingSummary: POWR>BARR; stream split E2 waves; PROC after the first force; scout before committing.
when: Short land routes and no completed anti-infantry defense line is known.
avoidWhen: Flame towers, Tesla coils, pillboxes, or vehicle-crush lanes are already confirmed.
opening: POWR then BARR immediately; income limits you early, not build speed
Stream E2 grenadiers continuously; the first two walk out as scouts
PROC after ~8 E2 so the flood never starves
Second BARR only if cash idles
composition: 12+ E2 grenadiers as the flood core
Split into 2-3 waves — E2 death explosions chain-kill a single clump
execution: queueMission sweep on the scout pair from minute one
queueMission pincer posture=assault targetPriority=production with two wings onto their FACT/WEAP
If defenses appear: strike targetPriority=economy instead — grenades erase power plants and refineries
reinforce the attacking squads with the fresh E2 stream every wave
pursue on enemyRetreating to convert a repelled defense into kills
Foot raiders at home: order your harvester over them — it crushes infantry

phases.name: opening
phases.objective: Create early map contact and a critical mass before vehicle production stabilizes.

phases.name: pressure
phases.objective: Use separated assault legs against production or exposed economy; keep reinforcements grouped.

abortTransitions.when: Two grouped attacks fail against confirmed anti-infantry defenses or vehicles.

claims.statement: Grenadiers are produced from the Soviet infantry queue and cost 150 credits.
Grenade damage is effective against wood and concrete but reduced against vehicle armor.
Grenadiers can explode on death, making tight friendly clumps hazardous.
Separated mission legs reduce death-explosion overlap while preserving simultaneous pressure.
Scout with the first small group instead of sending the complete production stream blind.
Stop the all-in after two failed waves and convert the economy into vehicle pressure.
